summary: Buffered stream read routine (mode-driven): reads a2 bytes from the audio/file stream object a1. Mode a3==0 reads at an absolute offset, a3==1 reads relative to the current position at a1+20; a3==2 returns -1. Lazily allocates 0x4000 scratch buffers (a1+68 / a1+72) via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc and fills them through BufferFillWithTimeout or BufferedFileReader loops, updating stream position fields. Called from file loaders, HDV parsing and resource dispatch paths.

operations.description: If a1 is null or a3 == 2, skip all read paths and fall through to return -1.
State dword at a1+56 must not equal -1 or -3, otherwise the read is refused.
Mode-byte check: when *(BYTE*)(a1+92) == 119 ('w') the absolute/relative stream-read path is taken.
When a3 == 0, v4 = a2 - *(DWORD*)(a1+8), making the request absolute relative to the stream offset stored at a1+8.
Lazily allocate a 0x4000 buffer via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc into a1+68 and zero it with memset(0x4000) when a1+68 is null.
Fill loop: repeatedly call BufferFillWithTimeout(a1, *(a1+68), min(0x4000, v4)), subtract the bytes filled from v4, and return *(a1+8) once v4 <= 0 or break when a fill call returns 0.
When a3 == 1, v4 = *(DWORD*)(a1+20) + a2, i.e. relative to the position tracked at a1+20.
When the flag at a1+88 is set: reset *(a1+4) to 0, set *a1 = *(a1+68), then call sub_587F64(*(a1+64), v4, 0); on success store v4 to a1+20 and a1+8 and return v4, else return -1.
When v4 < *(a1+20) call sub_5354E0(a1) (returns -1 on failure), otherwise subtract the stored position *(a1+20) from v4.
If v4 became 0 after the position adjustment, return *(DWORD*)(a1+20).
Lazily allocate a 0x4000 buffer into a1+72 via MallocWrapperForNhMalloc when it is null.
Read loop: repeatedly call BufferedFileReader(a1, *(a1+72), min(0x4000, v4)), subtract the bytes read from v4, and return *(a1+20) once v4 <= 0 or break when the reader returns <= 0.
Fallback return of -1 for any path that fails or is refused.

clean_pseudocode: int n = BufferFillWithTimeout(a1, dword_at(a1,68), min(0x4000, v4));
if (sub_587F64(dword_at(a1,64), v4, 0) >= 0) { dword_at(a1,20) = v4; dword_at(a1,8) = v4; return v4; }
int n = BufferedFileReader(a1, dword_at(a1,72), min(0x4000, v4));
